test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.

A. Some scientists think that the volcano could erupt in five minutes or five months.

B. They just don’t know.

C. On 28th September, steam appeared above Mount Agung, a volcano in Bali, Indonesia.

D. Scientists fear that an eruption could happen soon.
solution:
The correct answer is **'CDAB'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**The given jumbled sentences are about the **volcano that could be erupted in an uncertain time.**

__
 
• The **first sentence **talks about the volcano and its location, that is **(C) - *****On 28th September, steam appeared above Mount Agung, a volcano in Bali, Indonesia***
 
• The **second sentence **talks about the fear of scientists, that is **(D) - *****Scientists fear that an eruption could happen soon.***
 
• The **third sentence **will talk about the anticipation of the scientists, that is **(A) - *****Some scientists think that the volcano could erupt in five minutes or five months.***
 
• Now we are left with the fourth sentence, that is **(B) - *****They just don’t know.***

Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's understand the meaning of some given words.

 
• **Volcano **- *a mountain with a large, circular hole at the top through which lava (hot liquid rock) gases have been forced out.*
 
• **Erupt **- *when a volcano erupts, it explodes and flames come out of it.*
